messages.subject: mod_R version of R running
parts:
Hi there,

I have configured Rapache and it works very well.

But now i needed to update the R version (from 3.0.2 to 3.3.0) in my machine to load some packages and i noticed that the Rapache still continues with the previous version (3.0.2), meanwhile my machine is running 3.3.0.

Must have something to do with mod_r when is compiled with rapache?

Thanks in advance for the attention!

regards
